title: fix: default insecure configuration for silk ui
author: johnny-official
body_preview: ### Description  The `django-silk` profiling and inspection UI is unauthenticated and unauthorized by default (`SILKY_AUTHENTICATION` and `SILKY_AUTHORISATION` are `False`).
